new_features.name: Refresh Solana staking
new_features.description: Pull to refresh the Solana staking management screen to update the stake position, staking info and reward history.
new_features.platform_notes: Mobile only. StakingManagementScreen renders SolanaStakingRewardsList for Solana-type networks (sol, dsol) instead of the transaction list, so before 5aecb0d2e4 a Solana screen had no pull-to-refresh. A pull now runs three requests in parallel (Promise.allSettled): fetchAndUpdateAccountThunk for the account, which re-syncs its balance and stake position; refreshStakingProductInfoThunk({ force: true }) through the screen's onRefresh, which ignores the product-info maximum age; and a refetch of the Everstake rewards-history query. The rewards refetch runs only when the query is enabled, which means only for mainnet 'sol'. A devnet (dsol) pull refreshes the account and product info but leaves the rewards alone (follow-up 693ac50380). The spinner uses the brand colour and stays visible until all three settle. A failed request does not block the others. ETH and TRX management screens already had pull-to-refresh through TransactionList (onRefresh) and are not part of this intent. Desktop/web: the Solana staking dashboard has no equivalent pull-to-refresh control.

navigation.mobile: Earn tab (or Solana account) > Solana staking > staking management screen > pull down on the rewards list

evidence.detail: Tapping a staking position card on the Earn screen navigates to the StakingManagement route for the account (useStakingDetailNavigation).
Account/promo entry points open StakingManagement only when staking is active for the account; otherwise they open HowStakeWorksScreen.

Solana-type networks render SolanaStakingRewardsList with onRefresh={refreshProductInfoNow} (line 76). refreshProductInfoNow (line 46) dispatches refreshStakingProductInfoThunk({ force: true }). Other networks keep TransactionList with the same onRefresh (line 79).

handleRefresh sets isRefreshing and awaits Promise.allSettled of fetchAndUpdateAccountThunk({ accountKey }), onRefresh() and, only when rewardsQuery.isEnabled, rewardsQuery.refetch(). Then it clears isRefreshing.
FlashList refreshControl is a RefreshControl bound to isRefreshing/handleRefresh and coloured elementFillBrandBold.
refreshStakingProductInfoThunk refetches the staking product info; force sets staleTime 0 instead of PRODUCT_INFO_MAX_AGE_MS (line 153).
Rewards-history query enabled only for account.symbol === 'sol', so a devnet pull skips the rewards refetch.
